description: Election Commission - Declare that B. M. I. S. D. Basnayaka as a member of the Vavuniya North P/S
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling a vacancy in a local government body (Vavuniya North Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It addresses electoral processes at the local government level, including the declaration of a new member to fill a vacancy created by non-attendance of meetings. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authorities elections.
